verdict.rationale: Braintrust is an observability platform, so alerting is a fair axis, but the evidence pack never documents threshold alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or score drops, nor any Slack, PagerDuty, or email notification channels. The nearby features are not alerting: real-time tracking of latency, cost, and quality, dashboards, online scoring, scheduled Patterns, and a passing mention of "configure monitoring" via MCP.
